records.text: Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner found a 1,400-hectare private Mediterranean island after swimming to it from a friend's boat, and over several years developed the opportunity to transform it.
records.speaker: Ivanka Trump

appearances.snippet: it's an unbelievable, beautiful 1,400 hectare private island in the middle of the Mediterranean. We were on a friend's boat and we stopped for a swim. ... Effectively, that's how we found it. We swam to the islands, we went on a hike barefoot all the way up to the top, and we were just captivated and it stayed with us ever since. And over the course of many years, we developed the opportunity to help realize its potential and transform it, but with a lot of restraint and care because the land is so beautiful that really the architecture has to be.

verification.notes: Ivanka Trumps David Senra interview directly contains the 1,400-hectare description, the swim from a friends boat, the barefoot hike, and her statement that the opportunity developed over several years. PBS independently rebroadcast and contextualized the same remarks.

sources.title: Ivanka Trump on Building an Authentic Life
sources.relevance: Direct interview transcript containing the island size, swim, hike, and multi-year opportunity remarks.

records.text: Nikita Khrushchev said that a powerful fleet based at Sazan Island could put the Mediterranean from the Bosporus to Gibraltar under Soviet control.
records.speaker: Nikita Khrushchev

appearances.snippet: And according to Enver Hoxha, who was the former prime minister of Albania and was present, Khrushchev said of the island, quote, with a powerful fleet from here, we can have the whole of the Mediterranean, the Bosporus to Gibraltar, in our hands. We can control everyone, end quote.

verification.notes: Enver Hoxhas memoir records Khrushchev and Marshal Malinovsky saying from the Vlora-area villa at Uji i Ftohte that a powerful fleet could place the Mediterranean from the Bosporus to Gibraltar in their hands. The quotation is supported, but the source locates it at the Vlora bay area rather than specifically on or at Sazan Island, so the extracted location is overstated.

sources.title: The Khrushchevites, chapter 12
sources.relevance: Primary memoir source contains the quoted words and places them at Uji i Ftohte near Vlora.
